Multicast address plan
Every essence is its own group, and the group belongs to the sender — five receivers on one camera subscribe to one, not five. Two rules a table never shows: address and port must be unique together, and 32 groups collapse onto the same L2 address. That is why the MAC is on the sheet.
Pool (CIDR)

No pool declared — nothing is allocated. A pool of /9 or narrower cannot collide with itself; only a wider one frees the bit that drops 32 groups onto one MAC.
